list: Official 55 trophies — names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them (via Exophase / PSNProfiles listing, 2026-11-18). Guides are written for this entry, in our own words. Six trophies have no confirmed unlock method at launch: In The Beginning…, Capital Offense, Personal Best, Bad Luck, I Guess, The Truth Is Out There, Ten Pin.

roadmap.text: Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter: GTA VI has no mission replay and no New Game Plus. In Chapter 1, do Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house (after the mission Down to Earth) — it is the one missable step in the whole list. Then finish Gone Fishing and Chapter 1.
roadmap.title: Chapter 1 — do the balcony meditation first

roadmap.text: Play the story missions in order. Every chapter and mission trophy pops automatically; none of them can be missed. Save at the start of each chapter.
roadmap.title: Story — Chapters 2 to 5

roadmap.text: Finish the mission strands for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone, hunt the unique animal for Bret, and complete any 8 stranger strands across Leonida. All of it stays available in free roam after the story.
roadmap.title: Side characters and strangers

roadmap.text: Work the long grinds: 18 meditation spots, 3 card sets, 100 WAiNK spots, 42 gold Shooting Range challenges, 14 drone race locations, 20 different race wins, arcade, bowling, fishing against Cal and 50 challenges. Check your counts under Stats.
roadmap.title: Collectibles and activities

roadmap.text: Wanted levels with your partner, shop and bank robberies, Combat Focus, VCIA, the Rhino tank, gang operations for all 9 gangs, then the money trophies: launder $250,000 of Marked Bills, spend $100,000 in shops, buy all 8 garages and register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app.
roadmap.title: Combat, robbery and money

roadmap.text: Finish the 100% completion checklist, 250 stunts, 100 vehicles and all 52 areas of Leonida. The vague story trophies pop as you play. When the last one lands, the platinum pops with it.
roadmap.title: Cleanup and platinum

sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and the platinum pops on its own — there is no separate task. Plan around the long grinds (100% completion, 250 stunts, the collectibles) and keep a manual save at the start of every chapter, since GTA VI has no mission replay.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing — the first story mission of Chapter 1. It unlocks naturally as you play and cannot be missed; on a fresh save it is the first trophy you will earn.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1 by playing its missions in order; the trophy pops when the chapter ends. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude — it is the one missable step in the game.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. A story trophy: finish every mission in the chapter and it unlocks at the chapter's end. Nothing here is missable, and free roam stays open after the story.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. A story trophy: finish every mission in the chapter and it unlocks at the chapter's end. Keep a manual save at the chapter's start, just in case.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. A story trophy: finish every mission in the chapter and it unlocks at the chapter's end. Nothing here is missable.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. Keep a manual save before it — there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so a save is your safety net. Finish the story and the gold pops.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It pops when the mission ends; like every story trophy, it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It pops when the mission ends; like every story trophy, it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It pops when the mission ends; like every story trophy, it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. It pops when the mission ends; like every story trophy, it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. It pops when the mission ends; like every story trophy, it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It pops when the mission ends; like every story trophy, it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion. The checklist appears under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion after the story, and progress made during the story already counts. It covers the story, activities, collectibles and challenges, and it is the hardest trophy in the list — leave it for last and work through this guide's roadmap. Nothing toward 100% is missable.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts. Jumps, near-misses, drifts and airtime all count, across cars, bikes and boats, over the whole game. Chase them deliberately on long highway runs and jump ramps, and check your count under Stats. No stunt is missable.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. Fishing, the shooting range, drone races, arcade games, bowling, racing, hunting and meditation are among them; the tracker under Stats shows which types you have tried. Everything is available in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Use practice runs to learn the targets, take your time on the timed lanes, and work through the challenges in order — the earlier ones teach the later ones.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations across Leonida. Learn each course's gates on a practice run, then race to win; you can retry any location as often as you like.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Races count per event, not per win: win 20 distinct race events — street, off-road, boat and air races all count. Replaying the same race does not add to the total.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at a fishing spot and take his challenge; match the bait to the spot and keep the line tension in the safe zone. You can retry the challenge if you lose.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Walk into any arcade, pick a cabinet and play it through to the end. Any game counts — pick the shortest one if you only want the trophy.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Play his mission strand to its end; the trophy pops when his last mission is done. Side strands stay available in free roam, so nothing here is missable.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Play his mission strand to its end; the trophy pops when his last mission is done. Side strands stay available in free roam, so nothing here is missable.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Play his mission strand to its end; the trophy pops when his last mission is done. Side strands stay available in free roam, so nothing here is missable.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Strangers appear as icons on the map and each strand is a short chain of missions. There are more than 8 strands in the game, so finish any 8 you enjoy.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Play his mission strand to its end; the trophy pops when his last mission is done. Side strands stay available in free roam, so nothing here is missable.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Play his mission strand to its end; the trophy pops when his last mission is done. Side strands stay available in free roam, so nothing here is missable.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. There are 18 meditation spots across 10 locations, and meditating with Lucia and Jason at the same spot counts twice. THE MISSABLE ONE: the first meditation is Lucia on the balcony of Jason's house in Chapter 1 — after the mission Down to Earth, find Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept. It is gone once Chapter 1 ends, and there is no mission replay, so do it before you finish the chapter and keep a Chapter 1 manual save. Whether that spot is strictly required is unconfirmed, but do it anyway.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. His strand points you at a rare animal; track it, take the shot cleanly and bring it back. The strand is available in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida and each set needs all of its cards. Check your collection under Stats and sweep one region at a time.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK spots are marked around the map; interact with 100 of them. They are quick to hit, so fold them into your exploration routes.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the small tasks scattered through activities and free roam, and any 50 count. They pile up naturally as you play, so check Stats to see how close you are.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. Build a 4-star wanted level with your partner in the car, then break line of sight and stay hidden until it clears. The countryside and tunnels are good places to lose the cops.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Hit three shops in a row with your partner alongside and keep the wanted level from dropping between them — plan a route with three close shops and a fast car.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. A vehicle counts when you first drive it, and the tracker covers cars, bikes, boats and aircraft. Try everything you see — rental lots and traffic are the fastest way to tick them off.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Build up Combat Focus, then trigger it in a firefight with at least five enemies grouped up — gang hideouts are good for this — and drop five before the focus ends.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport: steal an aircraft on the runway and get airborne. Guides report the stolen-plane takeoff as the trigger; the description is deliberately vague, so this is the reading the guides agree on.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: The trigger is tied to the Rhino tank — guides report driving one. Head for the military compound, take a Rhino and drive it out. The description is a joke about the heat; the tank itself is the point.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case the store, wait for a quiet moment, take the goods without tripping the alarm or being spotted — a stealth approach with no witnesses. If you are spotted, leave and try again.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Vaults open during bank robberies; hit five and get clean away each time. Plan your escape route before you go in.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Trucks run set routes, so learn one and hit it where the road is quiet; stop the truck, crack it open and get away clean.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. There are 52 named areas; visit each one and the tracker ticks up. Drive the map edge to edge in free roam — the in-game Stats page shows which areas are left.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang. There are 9 gangs; hit one illegal operation for each. Operations show on the map in gang territory — clear one per gang.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch — the description reads like a story moment on Ocean Beach, so play the story and visit the beach bars as they open up. Do not grind for this one; it should come from playing.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: No confirmed method at launch — the description points to a showroom escape, likely a story beat. Play through the story and it should trigger; do not grind for it.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Go to the alley and bowl a full game — follow through on your throws. Any completed game counts.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: No confirmed method at launch — the description reads like a story moment about the partnership, so it should unlock as the story unfolds. Play through and check back.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: PlayStation tracks a count to 500 for this one — make choices across the game and the counter climbs. It should pop naturally over a full playthrough; keep playing and check Stats.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: No confirmed method at launch — the description suggests failing once and succeeding on the second try at something. Play on; it likely triggers from a story moment.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: No confirmed method at launch — the description suggests witnessing something strange, likely a story or side moment. Keep playing and exploring; it should come from the story.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: No confirmed method at launch — the description reads like knocking someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Try it in free roam; the trigger is unconfirmed, so treat this as a best guess.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; launder them through your contacts and the total climbs. Bank and vault jobs are the fastest source.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Clothes, weapons, food and cars all count. It adds up over a playthrough; if you are close, buy a big-ticket item.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. There are 8 garage properties to buy across Leonida; buy them all. They also give you somewhere to store the vehicles for Whip It Good.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the Scooter Bros app on your phone and register 10 vehicles you own or find. Any 10 count.
trophies.name: On the Spot
